name: Amelia - Enthusiastic and Expressive
description: A young British English woman's voice, clear and easy to understand. Expressive and enthusiastic, it's beautiful for narration, podcasts and social media such as YouTube, Tiktok, Reels and Stories. This studio-produced audio is great for a young woman's Gen-Z voice in audiobooks, high-quality video dubbing, advertising and reading.

name: Imogen - Warm & Professional British Storyteller
description: A premium global female voice optimized for high-end documentaries, professional audiobooks, and corporate training. Delivers a flawless 'Received Pronunciation' (RP) with an empathetic, conversational undertone.

name: Tamsin - Engaging British storyteller and narrator
description: Authentic British female voice with deep emotional resonance. Captures the nuances of a seasoned narrator—perfect for immersive audiobooks, dramatic documentaries, character-driven storytelling or short digital content.

name: Zoe - Witty and Reassuring
description: British-American, Female Voice, Posh for story telling.

name: Cate - Resonant, Deep and Elegant
description:
Cate is a deep, resonant British RP female voice, perfect for narration that requires gravitas, authority, and elegance. With a cinematic tone reminiscent of classic drama and documentary storytelling, Cate balances commanding presence with the ability to sound soothing and calm.

Ideal for: audiobooks, film trailers, guided meditations, educational content, characters (villain or otherwise) and prestige narration.

name: Evelyn - Resourceful and Ironic
description: A thoughtful, analytical and witty character voice.  Restrained, composed, intelligent, grounded and quietly powerful. A touch of London irony and grit. Inspired by Evie Frye from Assassin's Creed Syndicate. Perfect for a determined and insightful heroin in video games. Ideal for audio books or for dialogue requiring a focused and pragmatic female role with a dry sense of humour. Recorded by Global Artist in a professional studio.

name: Leona G - Lifestyle Reels Creator
description: Natural, expressive, and built for the kind of content people actually watch twice. Leona G has the easy charm of a creator who never sounds like she's trying — her British delivery is warm, observational, and effortlessly engaging. Built for lifestyle reels, day-in-life vlogs, brand collaborations, social media ads, and creator platforms where the voice itself is the personality that keeps people coming back.

name: Verity - Chatty, Fast-Paced, Fun Storyteller
description:
Female voice, Well-spoken british accent, Posh but not too posh.
Perfect for chatty voice overs, audiobooks, podcasts.
Fast-paced, engaging, chatty, 20-30s.

name: Tom - Light Northern British
description: A British male voice with a light Northern accent - Yorkshire, Lancashire, etc, along the lines of Alan Bennett, excellent for character reads and commercials

name: Kubz - Warm Northern British Narrator
description: A warm, grounded male voice with a natural Northern British accent. Clear, trustworthy and conversational, with calm authority and strong articulation. Ideal for e-learning, corporate training, documentaries, food and travel narration, explainers, audiobooks, advertising and branded social content. Authentic, professional and approachable without sounding overly theatrical.

name: Katie - Relatable & Humorous
description: Relatable & Humorous British Voice - A fun, animated voice perfect for social media reels and comedy podcasts. Katie’s delivery is incredibly casual, filled with witty sarcasm and high-energy storytelling. It feels exactly like listening to your best friend recount a wild weekend. Ideal for creators making engaging, fast-paced content, reality-style vlogs, and relatable lifestyle videos. Her natural charm guarantees your audience stays hooked until the end.

name: Canny
description: A lively Geordie voice from the North East, fast-paced and high-pitched, with a friendly, kindly gossiping tone that feels warm and engaging.

name: Emily - Soft & Sweet
description: A calm and soft british woman's voice. clear but warm and friendly.

name: Cleo - Cute, sweet and universally appealing
description: Cleo is a warm, friendly, and engaging voice designed to feel effortlessly human. With a natural charm, soft tone, and universally appealing cadence, Cleo is perfect for narration, conversational content, customer engagement, and digital storytelling. Whether you're creating calming audiobooks, approachable explainers, or emotional dialogue, Cleo delivers with authenticity and heart.

name: Zibby - Quirky, Nerdy & Dorky Sidekick
description: Zibby is a quirky, nerdy female character voice with lovable dorky energy, playful humor, and tons of personality. Awkward, animated, and expressive, she's perfect for animation, video games, NPCs, audiobooks, podcasts, and comedic narration. Ideal for nerdy best friends, awkward sidekicks, lovable weirdos, and quirky heroines. A distinctive, memorable AI voice that stands out from generic narrators — full of charm, character, and comedic timing.
